assertions.name: habiro_tail_double_root_bareven_noncyclotomic
assertions.source: D(n) has the universal (q−1)² double root (all n≥4) and is bar-even (all n); the post-(q−1)² cofactor is cyclotomic for n≤5 and non-cyclotomic bar-even for n≥6 (degrees 8,10,14,28…) ⇒ no finite general closed form (non-q-holonomic), the fork's structural cause.

description: Exact closed forms of the binding q-deformation Habiro tail D(n)=S(n)−S(n−1)−[n−1]_q S(n−2), n=4..9 (extends corpus D(4)=(q−1)²Φ₃). Derived invariants: (H1) universal (q−1)² double root at q=1 (Habiro signature) for all n≥4; (H2) bar-even D(1/q)=D(q) for all n; (H3) cyclotomic head × cofactor that is fully cyclotomic for n≤5 (D(5)=2(q−1)²Φ₂²Φ₃Φ₆/q) but NON-cyclotomic bar-even for n≥6 (deg 8,10,14,28…). No finite general closed form — the non-cyclotomic cofactor is non-q-holonomic, why S(n) forks from any fixed-order recurrence. Binding recurrence D(n), NOT the Q_β ladder c_k; nothing wired. Scope-(a).
